query: What pre-registered analytic plan (exact tests, Bayesian priors, bootstrap/permutation methods) is appropriate for mixed-methods small-N pilots (n≈30–40)?

response.query: What pre-registered analytic plan (exact tests, Bayesian priors, bootstrap/permutation methods) is appropriate for mixed-methods small-N pilots (n≈30–40)?
response.answer: For mixed-methods small-N pilots, Bayesian methods and permutation testing are appropriate. Bootstrap methods can also be useful for resampling.
